answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 295 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The sparrow graph is validated at intake and the mirror frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and pigment anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Bonded capital sits idle for 3 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
